Who I Am

Professional Profile

My background combines deep Nokia OSS expertise with modern SMO, autonomous-network, AI-enabled automation, solution architecture, and pre-sales leadership. I have worked with major North American operators and spent more than two decades inside a global telecom vendor, giving me firsthand understanding of how OSS and SMO solutions are shaped, positioned, sold, challenged, and delivered in real operator environments.

20+ years Nokia / NSN experience
Tier-1 North American operator experience
OSS + SMO Deep network-management expertise
Available Permanent + contract opportunities

My career spans the full technology lifecycle: operating live networks, deploying and integrating platforms, leading technical delivery, shaping architectures, and helping customers make investment decisions. That combination lets me connect an executive discussion to the engineering and operational work required to deliver it.

Beyond telecom, I bring transferable strengths in enterprise solution engineering, technical account management, cloud infrastructure, customer success, program governance, vendor performance, and practical automation. I work across sales, product, engineering, support, delivery, and customer teams to turn requirements into coordinated action.

For hiring teams

A few useful details.

What is the strongest fit for your background?

Roles combining technical depth with customer-facing responsibility: OSS / SMO solution architecture, technical pre-sales, solutions engineering leadership, technical account management, and complex technology delivery. My experience spans both hands-on engineering and executive engagement.

Can your experience transfer beyond telecom?

Yes. Discovery, enterprise integration, cloud infrastructure, platform adoption, governance, escalation handling and technical storytelling are transferable. My independent PulseHub demo and practical ecommerce experience show how I apply those skills in other domains, while telecom remains my deepest specialization.

Are you available for permanent roles or consulting?

Both. I am open to permanent leadership and solution architecture roles, as well as consulting, advisory, part-time and project-based work. Contact me to discuss the scope, working arrangement and timing.

Can you provide references and a role-specific résumé?

Yes. Senior Nokia references can be provided to help validate technical depth, customer impact and long-term OSS expertise. I can also provide a résumé focused on the responsibilities of your role.
